# Don't ship bugs

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Environments
- What: Separate copies of the app for building, testing and real users, so tests never touch real data.
- Applies when: the app is going live.
- Stage: go-live
- Kind: checkable

### Store times in UTC
- What: Save every time on one standard clock, and convert it to each user's time zone when showing it.
- Applies when: the app stores dates or times.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: Times are stored in UTC and shown in the user's time zone. A test saves a time in one time zone and reads it in another, and both show the same moment.
